note: SharePoint list-item capture scope (integrations/capture_sharepoint_lists). It names only lists whose data exists nowhere else: the Vendor Quotes list the Portal's public RFQ form writes vendors' packaging quotes to, on the Portal's fallback site and list ids (plx-customer-portal@31a2623 portal/src/app/api/rfq/submit/route.ts:5,26-33,146-176; RFQ_SHAREPOINT_SITE_ID / RFQ_VENDOR_QUOTES_LIST_ID override them on Vercel: a deployment that sets other ids writes another list, which this scope does not name; which ids production uses is live-unverified). The columns are the fields that route writes; no other column is read. The Portal form lists and the Mission Control mirror lists stay out: they copy systems the Workbench captures. This file grants nothing: the capture principal still needs the live-source audience, and every reader is re-gated per item on the item permissions captured with it.
